steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Set the risk parameters, decide between automatic and manual, and practise on the demo account.

pros: No platform fees on top of spreads.
redFlags: The fee that is not a fee: spreads embedded in every trade.
Restriction lists that name different countries.
Payout promises with no processing detail.

faqs.a: The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.

faqs.q: What does the published score actually mean?
faqs.a: It does double duty - a platform score and an early community response - and neither is independently verified. Treat both as marketing until proven otherwise.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.
US$300, funded by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill. It is trading capital in your balance, not a fee - and it is exposed to market risk once live.
9 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.

bottomLine: Tesoralta is a standard-issue AI trading desk with the usual strengths and the usual omissions. None of the omissions are dealbreakers - they are conditions.
The final score lands at 4.7 - a capable platform held back by its own paperwork. Start small, verify the claims yourself and never trade money you cannot lose.
